2000: Cortech Rock Insulated Food Tray
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-2000-the-rock-insulated-food-tray
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/food-service/correctional-food-trays/rock-tray/
Spec sheet: 2000
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Rock Insulated Food Tray – 2000
Current H1: Cortech The Rock Insulated Food Tray - 2000
Subtitle: Seamless One-Piece Insulated Meal Tray with Five Food and Two Condiment Compartments
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 2000C, 2000DG, 2000TC, 2000O
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Rock Insulated Food Tray is a seamless, one-piece meal tray for prisons, jails, and other correctional facilities. It has five insulated food compartments and two condiment compartments for bulk condiments, and it stacks with or without lids.
The tray is molded from high impact “no break” polypropylene made with FDA-approved material. Its one-piece design keeps water out, and the radius corners and softly beveled bottom make it easier to eat from and to clean. The Rock fits the Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., Chuckwagon Max, and Tray Master delivery carts.
Material: One-piece, seamless high impact “no break” polypropylene; does not absorb water
Compartments: Five insulated food compartments and two condiment compartments for bulk condiments
Dimensions: 14¼”L×9½”W×1¾”H; food compartments are 1¼” deep
Weight: 2 lbs per tray
Corners: Radius corners and a softly beveled bottom make it easier to eat from and to clean
Stacking: Stacks with or without lids
Cart Capacity: 150 Rock Trays (96 with lids) in the Chuckwagon, 88 (56 with lids) in the Chuckwagon Jr., or 156 in the Tray Master
Food Safety: Made with FDA-approved material
Care: Do not use bleach on the trays
Colors: Brown, Dark Gray, Terracotta, or Orange (custom colors available on request)
Packaging: Sold in cases of 10
Warranty: 5-year factory warranty
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
2000C – Brown: Rock Tray
2000DG – Dark Gray: Rock Tray
2000TC – Terracotta: Rock Tray
2000O – Orange: Rock Tray
Lids: Matching Rock lids sold separately
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The Rock suits facilities that serve meals on trays and need a tray that will not crack or absorb water.
Typical applications include:
Inmate meal service in prisons, jails, and detention centers
Central kitchens that deliver meals to housing units
Juvenile detention and other secure facilities
Explore Anchortex's Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection for more food trays, delivery carts, and food service supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Food Service
Cortech food service products are made for high-volume meal service in correctional facilities, where trays, carts, and dispensers are used and washed every day. Cortech trays and delivery carts are sized to work together.
Cortech food service includes:
Insulated Food Trays: The Rock, Rock 2.0, Rock with Cor-Flex, and X-Tray, with matching lids
Tray Delivery Carts: The insulated Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., and Chuckwagon Max, and the non-insulated Tray Master
Beverage Service: The BevMax insulated beverage dispenser
Tray Drying: Aluminum meal tray drying racks
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (52 characters): Cortech Rock Insulated Food Tray - 2000 at Anchortex
Meta description (148 characters): Shop the Cortech Rock Tray. A seamless one-piece insulated meal tray with five food and two condiment compartments that stacks with or without lids.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Food Service" is a new section for the food service pages (trays, lids, delivery carts, BevMax, and drying racks). It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Rock Tray, so I took out "The."
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty against breakage, cracking, or leaking. The Cortech spec sheet says 5-year factory warranty, so I used that.
Cart capacity: your current page says 132 trays in the Chuckwagon and 80 in the Chuckwagon Jr. The Cortech spec sheet and web page say 150 and 88, so I used those.
Compartment depth: the Cortech spec sheet says the Rock uses 1.25” from top to bottom of the feeding surface, and the tray is 1.75” high.
Variant names: your variants say "Chocolate Brown," "Dark Grey," and "Terra Cotta." The Cortech spec sheet says "Brown," "Dark Gray," and "Terracotta." Would you like them renamed, for example "2000C - Brown"?
Weight: your variants are set to 24 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 2 lbs per tray, so a case of 10 is about 20 lbs. I left the variant weight for you to decide.
Case pricing: Cortech sells the trays in cases of 10. Your current pages do not say whether the price is per tray or per case. I wrote "Sold in cases of 10." Is your price per case?
Bleach: the Cortech spec sheet says "Do not use bleach on food trays," so I added it as a Care bullet.
Collection link: I linked the Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection, which this product is already in.
Product images: the page has one image. The Cortech product page has six more photos: the Rock Tray in orange, gray, and brown, and the Rock lid in gray, orange, and brown. Would you like me to add them?
